slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice B2

findings.red: On 566c2d69, Ch4A principals and Ch4B1 persist_and_enqueue exist, but nothing consumes a canonical policy issuance, persists authentic material+queue identity through producer authority, and returns staff-safe would-send/handoff evidence. A later worker or HTTP path could invent that comparison or jump to claim/journal/provider.
findings.green: One default-off shadow orchestrator owns that sequence. It reuses issueAndDecide, eligibility, 086 audit, and producer persist_and_enqueue. It never mints policy evidence, never claims, never journals, and never invokes a provider.

findings.red: JSON clones and copied WeakSet objects are unissued. Without a closed owner, a caller could treat them as sendable or persist caller-trusted facts.
findings.green: Forged/copied/JSON issuance is deterministic would-not-send (unissued_evidence). No audit row, no queue row, send_allowed false.

findings.red: A caller could pass tenant, location, recipient, provider, facts, capability, would_send, or a provider callback and obtain a send-capable decision.
findings.green: Factory binds env+tenant_location_gate only. Envelope authority is the tenant source. Extra send/provider/claim/handoff/result keys fail closed. Projection is derived, never caller-selected, and always send_allowed=false / auto_send_allowed=false / provider_invoked=false / mode=shadow.

findings.red: Stale consumed decisions, tenant/location/recipient/thread rebinding, persist replay, or a claim/handoff/send method could transition past shadow into a send-capable path.
findings.green: Stale/unsafe/unsupported stay would-not-send. Rebinding and gate mismatch fail closed. Replay of the same identity stays pending/replayed would-send with one queue row. Orchestrator has no claim/handoff/send. Queue state other than pending is conflict/would-not-send. Runtime composition stays unwired.
